primer.strongest_challenge: A candidate scope could become a live-publication bypass through an arbitrary or replaced directory, exception leakage, or concurrent use. Path equality alone is insufficient.
primer.best_alternative: Bind context-local isolation to validated migration receipt/work identity, recheck identity before completion, reset the token in finally, and retain attempt CAS and candidate validation.

docs_contract_seat.question_1_answer: Requirements 1-2 and AC1-2 require only the exact owned candidate to receive isolation. Delivery evidence must exercise live, wrong and replaced paths, exception restoration, concurrent publication, and unknown/pending-memory and stale-attempt refusals. These are required tests, not results claimed at readiness.
docs_contract_seat.question_2_answer: Requirements 3-4 and AC3-4 require retained staged recovery with the original package/source identity, a check-before-apply hash-pinned repair and exact CLI replay without re-extraction. Live parent publication and fresh verification remain mandatory before cleanup. The plan is sufficient; the actual repair continuation remains to be proven during implementation.
docs_contract_seat.alternative_assessment: Changing only the memory root is weaker: finalize_build_epoch would authorize the live run and write a parent receipt pointing to staging, then return without completing the candidate epoch. Global environment stripping can interfere with concurrent live work. A context-local, identity-bound candidate adapter is the smallest acceptable planned change.
docs_contract_seat.documentation_requirement: Distinguish candidate epoch completion from live memory publication in architecture, canonical seed 160 and project upgrade prompt. A checked-in repair generator is distinct from its generated payload and retained backups, which must remain outside shipped assets.

code_grounding: sqlite_storage_migration._migrate_schema8: clears retained staging, backs up source, writes staged receipt and invokes the real graph builder on staging_index
index_state_store.finalize_build_epoch: inherits memory/parent-receipt environment, derives root from index_dir and authorizes memory before writing the parent receipt
upgrade_wavefoundry.phase_index_update_parent_owned: validates child completion, live publishing_index state and parent CAS before storage verification

synthesis.anonymized_merit_pass: Seat A requires identity-bound authority and restoration; Seat B confirms separate candidate/live contracts and rejects root-only repair. Both requirements are already explicit in the plan; neither introduces a readiness blocker.
improvements_recommended: Make directory identity and concurrency negative controls explicit in delivery evidence.
Exercise the generated repair with its exact documented CLI continuation, not only the patched migration function.

known_bad_control: Code-grounded root-only counterexample: inherited parent receipt branch calls authorize_index_finalize and writes staging index_dir into the live receipt, then returns before candidate CAS. Requirements 1 and AC1 reject both premature live mutation and incomplete candidate completion.
limitations: Readiness review of the actual plan and current production call path. No unimplemented regression, repair CLI, native Windows/Linux or delivery behavior is claimed tested. Dry-run prepare passed lint/gardening, required the six listed delivery lanes, and correctly withheld activation pending typed readiness.

reprepare_review.scope: Corrected Requirement 1 and AC1 distinguish historical-backfill authority from an existing disposable staging memory cache; no runtime scope expansion.
independent_inspection: sqlite_storage_migration._staging_allowlist explicitly permits never-published memory-state.sqlite generated by real memory-record walks.
indexer._build_index_locked invokes memory_invalidate(index_dir) when changed/removed paths contain a memory record.
index_state_store.memory_invalidate advances the supplied index cache generation; it does not authorize historical backfill.
reprepare_review.question_1_answer: Unchanged exact-candidate identity, exception/concurrency and live-refusal controls still apply. Candidate success must forbid staging historical-backfill tables and premature live run/receipt changes, not forbid every memory-state.sqlite file.
reprepare_review.question_2_answer: Unchanged: pinned repair and exact continuation must retain package/source/receipt identity, permit no memory copying, and complete live publication plus fresh verification before cleanup. Disposable cache output supplies no authority.
reprepare_review.known_bad_control: The root-only redirect remains invalid because live authorization/parent receipt mutation precedes candidate completion. The earlier no-memory-file criterion was overbroad: _staging_allowlist and memory_invalidate establish legitimate cache output.
reprepare_review.limitations: Read-only re-Prepare assessment of plan, architecture prose and production symbols. No new tests executed or delivery verification claimed.
